baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative construction selects among ءَالَاءِ, relates them to رَبِّكُمَا, and challenges the dual addressees through تُكَذِّبَانِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concrete benefactions belong to and are administered by a shared Lord; the pair is required to identify which item, if any, can bear a verdict of falsehood.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the concrete class selected by the question.
Lordship and ownership supply the giver whose benefactions are under review.
Attributing falsehood supplies the challenged response of the two addressees.

changed_reading.after: A dual, itemizing challenge: identify which specific benefaction of your shared Lord can responsibly be pronounced false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبِّكُمَا and تُكَذِّبَانِ permit an eventive reading of what the Lord does and whether that doing proves true.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor is not only an owned object but an act of repair, nurture, and staged completion; denial can therefore function as a verdict that this cultivating performance failed its charge.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor remains the literal object while being recast as an accomplished benefit.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship a staged productive process.
A charge proving true or failing supplies the performance test applied to nurture.

changed_reading.before: The favors are static gifts and denial is only verbal.
changed_reading.after: Each favor can be heard as completed cultivation: which act of your Lord's care will you two judge not to have carried through?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The favor noun, the shared Lord relation, and the intensive denying verb remain explicit while adjacent branches add oath, pact, and fulfilled-charge valence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Receiving benefaction creates a binding relational claim: favor resonates with oath, lordship with covenant, and denial with failing to carry a charge through.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors keep the model grounded in the surface noun.
The oath branch lends binding force to receipt of those favors without replacing their literal sense.
A covenant or pact turns the Lord-recipient relation into an inspectable commitment.
A charge made true by completion makes denial potentially performative rather than merely propositional.

changed_reading.before: The pair is asked whether it believes a report about gifts.
changed_reading.after: The pair is asked which received benefaction, carrying a claim from its Lord, it will refuse to ratify by fulfilled response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual ending of تُكَذِّبَانِ and the split mapping attached to ءَالَاءِ allow the question to be heard as a response slot for two voices.
baseline_models.mechanism: The literal favor question coexists with a non-dominant sequence-and-response activation: one voice poses the charge and another voice follows it, while the dual addressees are positioned to answer together.

activation_trace.role: The favor branch preserves what the call is about.
The non-dominant voice-following-voice branch supplies an antiphonal possibility without replacing the noun.
Shared lordship gives the two respondents one point of address.
Declaring false supplies the answer-position that the call demands.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained rhetorical question spoken in one direction.
changed_reading.after: A call about favors that opens a paired response slot, with one utterance expecting answering voices.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence of mercy, taught recitation, distinguishing marks, and disclosed meaning makes the refrain an exercise of a taught faculty: speech can recognize a sign or misuse that gift by classifying it as false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor makes the capacity for recognition itself part of what is being tested.
Declaring something false becomes an act of classification performed with taught speech.
Mercy and tenderness establish the affective source of the teaching sequence.
A distinguishing trace that guides recognition supplies the epistemic operation later tested.
Reading and recitation supply the voiced discipline in which the question is learned and repeated.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes denial a possible corruption of البيان.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 forms a compact mercy-teaching-creation-articulation sequence before any refrain occurs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, taught recitation, a guiding mark, disclosed meaning, and the focus denial; I infer that the refrain exercises the supplied faculty of recognition, while the live alternative is that the opening only establishes provenance.

changed_reading.after: Which disclosed signs of your nurturing Lord will you use your taught speech to misclassify as false?

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier demand to align two sides, act justly, and not underfill a measure turns acknowledgment into accounting: denying a received benefit is a deficient weighing of the Lord-recipient relation.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply what must be counted without deficit.
Calling a favor false becomes the inaccurate verdict placed on the scale.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies the relational measurement mechanism.
Justice and equity make accurate acknowledgment an ethical rather than merely cognitive act.
Underfilling measure supplies the concrete failure-pattern for undercounting favor.

structural_cues: The balance passage uses prohibition and command before the first catalog of earthly provisions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alignment, justice, underfilled measure, and a question that selects among favors; I supply the arrow that denial underweights the giver-recipient account, while literal commercial and cosmic balance remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an isolated false statement.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also false accounting: which benefit will the two of you undercount and thereby make the scale of acknowledgment deficient?

context_deltas.mechanism: Thirty non-focus occurrences of the exact question convert the focus instance from a lone query into one beat of an ordered call-and-response chain; the split sequence and answering-voice branches become structurally audible.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice supplies the focus instance's antiphonal potential.
The denial verb supplies the stable answer-position repeated by the call.
Following in sequence makes the first refrain the start of an accumulating succession.
The later answering-voice image closes the chain as a responsive cadence rather than mere duplication.

structural_cues: The exact focus sentence occurs thirty times outside 55:75 and retains dual address throughout.
Each recurrence follows a new assertion, so the semantic load is cumulative even when the wording is fixed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence plus sequence and voice-following branches; I infer a disciplined response pattern in which each new assertion renews the question, while rhythmic punctuation without an implied answer remains viable.

changed_reading.before: One rhetorical question asks for one judgment.
changed_reading.after: This occurrence is a recurring response station: the pair must answer the whole preceding sequence again, not only the nearest gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairs meet, remain connected across an interval, and do not overrun their limit; paired fruits repeat the pattern. The dual addressees can thus be heard as distinct but coordinated witnesses whose answers meet without collapsing into one voice.

activation_trace.role: The shared favors provide common evidence for both witnesses.
One lordship holds the two addressed parties within a common relation.
The dual act of declaring false becomes coordinated testimony.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies the meeting of distinct respondents.
A connection standing between parties lets distinction and relation coexist.
Not crossing a limit gives the pair a rule for remaining jointly ordered.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart repeats the pairing logic inside the gift catalog.

structural_cues: Dual nouns and verbs recur across cosmic, human-jinn, marine, and garden scenes before the dual suffixes of 55:75.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting counterparts, a between-connection, a non-transgressed limit, and paired produce; I map that architecture onto the dual addressees as coordinated testimony, while simple descriptive symmetry remains an alternative.

changed_reading.before: The dual merely addresses two recipients at once.
changed_reading.after: The two are separately implicated but jointly examined: which shared evidence will either voice falsify when its answer must meet the other's?

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit contrast between what ceases after duration and the Lord who remains separates the lifetime of a benefit's carrier from the truth of benefaction; disappearance need not mean that provision failed its promise.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor is the benefit whose duration is being reconsidered.
Staying and lasting supply persistence on the Lord side of the relation.
A milk supply judged false because it did not last supplies the material analogy of disappointed duration.
Cessation after a period of continuance supplies the finite side of the contrast.
Endurance supplies the continuing source after finite carriers vanish.
Face standing for the self locates persistence in the giver rather than in each gift form.

structural_cues: 55:26 and 55:27 form an adjacent universal-finitude versus remaining-source antithesis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, endurance, the Lord's self, and a focus branch for milk that disappoints by ending; I infer that expiry can tempt a false verdict on benefaction, while the simpler alternative is only a mortality-sovereignty contrast.

changed_reading.before: A benefit that disappears may look as though it never made good on its promise.
changed_reading.after: Which favors will you call failed merely because their temporary vessels ended, when their administering Lord remains?

context_deltas.mechanism: Springs, flow, continuous giving, and gushing abundance activate a supply-system reading of favor; the denial branch of milk that unexpectedly ceases asks whether the recipients will label a visibly maintained provision unreliable.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors are recast as maintained flows rather than isolated objects.
Nurture and completion supply the maintaining agency behind the flows.
Milk failing to persist supplies the contrary image of a provision stream that disappoints expectation.
A spring as the source of running water supplies the provision's visible origin.
Continuous sustenance and giving turn literal flow into an ongoing provisioning mechanism.
Water welling up in abundance intensifies the model from passive possession to active renewal.

structural_cues: The garden sequence repeats paired water sources and interleaves them with fruit and refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies springs, flow, a branch for continuous provision, gushing water, and the focus image of milk that fails by ceasing; I infer supply reliability as their shared material logic, while accidental idiomatic overlap remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The favors are a completed inventory to be acknowledged.
changed_reading.after: The favors are live delivery systems: which continuously renewed provision of your Lord will you two treat as a supply that has failed?

context_deltas.mechanism: Good answered by good supplies reciprocity, the next refrain supplies oath resonance, and the close supplies covenant plus stable growing good; truthful acknowledgment becomes the recipient's return performance within a durable relation.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making lends binding force to the favor question without displacing its ordinary noun sense.
A pact makes the shared Lord relation reciprocal and durable.
A charge proving true through completion supplies the required response-performance.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the reciprocal arrow.
Doing good identifies both the received action and the fitting returned action.
The refrain immediately after reciprocity renews the oath-like pressure to answer.
The closing Lord reference carries pact imagery into the surah's final resolution.
Stable growing good supplies the durable benefaction that outlasts each individual response.

structural_cues: 55:60's reciprocal question is immediately followed by the exact refrain at 55:61.
The final refrain at 55:77 is answered structurally by the blessing of the Lord's name at 55:78.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, enacted good, oath and pact branches, repeated questioning, and stable growing good; I infer truthful acknowledgment as the recipient's reciprocal performance, while a non-contractual praise reading remains live.

changed_reading.before: The addressees need only avoid an incorrect answer.
changed_reading.after: Acknowledgment itself is a returned good: denial defaults on the relational response elicited by received benefaction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate scene layers confinement to a protected limit, the visible and hidden orders, and absence of prior approach. Favor can therefore include unbreached integrity, while denial can be enacted by violating the very boundary that makes the gift whole.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor allows protected integrity, not only possession, to count as benefaction.
Lordship supplies the authority under which the limit is held.
A charge made false by failure permits denial to be expressed through conduct.
Being held to a limit supplies the protected perimeter around the immediate scene.
Visible humanity contrasted with the hidden order supplies one side of the exhaustive social scope.
The hidden jinn supply the counterpart, extending the boundary across both addressed orders.
Precedence and what came earlier supply the claim that no prior crossing occurred.

structural_cues: The branchless ط م ث occurrence at 55:74 is used only as the immediate negative-contact construction; no mapped root or branch identity is assigned to it.
55:74 coordinates human and jinn under one negation before the focus refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a held limit, both social orders, precedence, and branchless negative contact; I infer that making this protected state false can occur by boundary-violating conduct, while verbal gratitude for an untouched reward remains the immediate alternative.

changed_reading.before: Which attractive reward will you verbally deny?
changed_reading.after: Which protected integrity granted by your Lord will you make false in conduct by refusing the boundary that preserves it?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-activates rare material branches, but it remains anchored in the focus denial root's deceptive-cloth branch and in immediate patterned furnishings whose own root also carries a pure-falsehood branch. Render it only as an appearance-and-credibility resonance, never as a replacement translation for either تُكَذِّبَانِ or عَبْقَرِىّ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ at 55:75 stands immediately before the patterned furnishing of 55:76, while earlier garden bedding explicitly exposes textile layers.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor keeps the marvelous material scene within the question's literal scope.
A variegated cloth that deceives by its appearance turns denial into a problem of reading surfaces.
Spread bedding and furnishings establish the textile field before the focus verse.
The same furnishing root's falsehood branch makes the material-veridical overlap explicit but form-distant.
Cloth lining supplies an inner layer against which deceptive outer appearance can be tested.
Fine patterned carpets provide the immediate post-question object.
The same rare root's pure-falsehood branch sharpens why extraordinary splendor might be dismissed as fabricated.

changed_reading.before: Denial is solely a propositional rejection of favors.
changed_reading.after: At the threshold of impossible-looking textiles, the question also stages an evidentiary problem: splendor may be called fabricated because it looks too artful, yet surface appearance alone cannot settle whether a favor is true.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a structural resonance from the non-dominant split mapping and the near-terminal position of 55:75. It remains anchored in the focus occurrence and the exact later refrain, but downstream prose must not translate ءَالَاءِ as remainder or last breath; those images describe how this recurrence carries the surah's accumulated claim into its close.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ءَالَاءِ is the penultimate occurrence of the exact refrain, three verses before the close.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary favor branch preserves the cumulative subject carried by the refrain.
A remainder following what came before figures this late recurrence as residue of all earlier questions.
The last-breath image gives near-terminal pressure to the focus occurrence.
Cessation after persistence supplies the surah-level horizon of ending.
What remains after something passes supplies the counter-image of carried residue.
The final refrain becomes the small remainder that follows the focus recurrence.
Stable growing good receives the accumulated question after its final breath.

changed_reading.before: 55:75 repeats the same local question once more.
changed_reading.after: As the penultimate refrain, 55:75 carries the remainder of every prior favor-question into the surah's last breath and hands that cumulative claim toward the enduring blessed name.

strongest_changes: The opening pedagogy turns denial into misuse of taught recognition and speech.
Balance language recasts denial as undercounting or underweighting received good.
Exact recurrence turns the focus verse into an antiphonal response station carrying cumulative evidence.
The perish-remain contrast separates a gift's finite vessel from the trustworthiness of its source.
Immediate furnishing branches expose a contained but unusually exact textile-falsehood resonance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots themselves split across favor, oath, sequence, nurture, covenant, duration, denial, failed performance, and deceptive surface; the surah context activates several of these as coexisting mechanisms rather than forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant ت ل و mapping may mark genuine rhetorical activation or only a remote lexical echo.
The covenant and supply-failure branches may deserve only analogical, not interpretive, weight.
The branchless ط م ث cue supports structure only, so the protected-integrity model cannot claim a lexical branch mechanism for it.
The textile convergence is unusually exact but must remain a qualified resonance rather than a translation.
